summary_en: The video captures an impressive lion dance performance on stage, featuring a yellow lion costume executing balancing, leaping, and movement across high training poles in front of an audience and judges. Concurrently, performers in matching uniforms play traditional drums and gongs to provide musical accompaniment for the routine.
